q-3900.name: Question 1
q-3900.worked_solution:
To find $f(a+2),$ we write down the function $f$ and replace every occurrence of $x$ with $(a+2):$

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & ={x}^{2}-6x+9 \\ f(a+2) & =(a+2)^{2}-6(a+2)+9\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we simplify as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(a+2) & =(a+2)^{2}-6(a+2)+9 \\  & =(a+2)(a+2)-6a-12+9 \\  & ={a}^{2}+2a+2a+4-6a-3 \\  & ={a}^{2}-2a+1\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(a+2)={a}^{2}-2a+1.$

Evaluate f(x)=x2−6x+9 at x=a+2.

a

a2+2a+1

Correct
EXPLANATION

To find f(a+2), we write down the function f and replace every occurrence of x with (a+2):

f(x)=x2−6x+9f(a+2)=(a+2)2−6(a+2)+9

Then, we simplify as follows:

f(a+2)=(a+2)2−6(a+2)+9=(a+2)(a+2)−6a−12+9=a2+2a+2a+4−6a−3=a2−2a+1

q-66446.name: Question 2
q-66446.worked_solution:
To find $f(2p-1),$ we write down the function $f$ and replace every occurrence of $x$ with $(2p-1):$

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & ={x}^{2}+2x-5 \\ f(2p-1) & =(2p-1)^{2}+2(2p-1)-5\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we simplify as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(2p-1) & =(2p-1)^{2}+2(2p-1)-5 \\  & =(2p-1)(2p-1)+4p-2-5 \\  & =4{p}^{2}-2p-2p+1+4p-7 \\  & =4{p}^{2}-6\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(2p-1)=4{p}^{2}-6.$

b
4p2−6
c
4p2+2p−6
d
4p2+4p−5
e
4p2−4p−5
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

To find f(2p−1), we write down the function f and replace every occurrence of x with (2p−1):

f(x)=x2+2x−5f(2p−1)=(2p−1)2+2(2p−1)−5

Then, we simplify as follows:

f(2p−1)=(2p−1)2+2(2p−1)−5=(2p−1)(2p−1)+4p−2−5=4p2−2p−2p+1+4p−7=4p2−6

Therefore, f(2p−1)=4p2−6.

q-222425.name: Question 3
q-222425.worked_solution:
First, we note that $(f∘f)(x)$ is equivalent to $f(f(x)).$

To find $f(f(x)),$ we write down the function $f$ and replace every occurrence of $x$ with $f(x):$

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =2{x}^{2}-1 \\ f(f(x)) & =2(f(x))^{2}-1\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we substitute $f(x)=2{x}^{2}-1$ into the right-hand side of the above and simplify, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(f(x)) & =2(f(x))^{2}-1 \\  & =2(2{x}^{2}-1)^{2}-1 \\  & =2(4{x}^{4}-4{x}^{2}+1)-1 \\  & =8{x}^{4}-8{x}^{2}+1\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $(f∘f)(x)=8{x}^{4}-8{x}^{2}+1.$
